title: Leroy's patio, Frog, George Williams and Blanche Thomas
summary: Williams recalls musicians who worked with him at Leroy's and the Blue Angel, and Blanche Thomas as his vocalist.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Yeah. You know, when I went in there sometime, Willie Humphrey would be there with you. Do you remember that?

Well, I'm happy to play some chimes, which I mean he wouldn't ever mention that he played with such a small musician like me, you know. Many of them wouldn't. Yeah, but I was there. I remember. Yeah, but I know you know. Just like, you remember when I was working for Leroy, the first patio out in there on Boyfriend Street? Mm-hmm. And I had Frog, Tramore Man, Frog. I had Jack Willis. I have Kimball, the big clarinet player that died there. Sam Dutre. And all those boys working with me. But right now, they wouldn't even mention that they worked with a small fry like me. Yeah, during that time, I had those people working with me. Did you ever know George Williams? We worked a long time.
Are you any kin to George Williams? No, I'm not kin to George Williams. Did you ever know him?

The drummer George Williams? Yeah. Sure, I know George. Good. I worked with George. I worked in George Band. During the time him and Poirier worked together. And we worked at that same plate that he called the Blue Angel on Boyfriend Street in the 200 block. Long time ago. Long time ago. I worked with George. George and Poirier? George and Poirier. And who else? Do you remember? I don't remember. I can't recall.
And did George ever work in your band? No, George never worked in my band. Not regular. No.

Did you ever know Blanche Thomas? Blanche Thomas was vocal with my group. Where? At Leroy Place. During the time I was just telling this now about Frog and Jack and them working with me. But Blanche was working during the time with us. Yeah, she was vocal during the time.
